V_T.myCAF.description: Myofibroblastic cancer-associated fibroblasts. Secrete ECM, CXCL12, TGFb, VEGF. Build desmoplastic barrier. Favored by TGFb signaling (Biffi 2019).

V_T.CXCL12.description: CXCL12/SDF-1 chemokine secreted by iCAFs. Major T cell exclusion mechanism in PDAC via CXCR4 signaling (Elyada 2019, Ogawa 2021).

V_T.IL6.description: Interleukin-6 inflammatory cytokine secreted by iCAFs. Promotes MDSC recruitment, M2 polarization, tumor progression.

V_T.IL1.description: Interleukin-1alpha in tumor compartment. Tumor-derived; drives iCAF formation via NF-kB/LIF/JAK-STAT3. TGFb antagonizes signaling by downregulating IL-1R1.

EC50_P1_mature.description: EC50 for antigen-dependent APC maturation. Lowered from 10 nM to 0.1 nM on 2026-04-21 (Fix 3): with the 10 nM value, V_ID.P1_GVAX (~0.009 nM steady state) produced a Hill factor of ~0.0009 in J_mature_ID, so GVAX-derived antigen was never a meaningful contributor to APC maturation — maturation proceeded almost entirely via the GMCSF + baseline APC terms. 0.1 nM is an estimated value in the nanomolar-affinity range typical of peptide/antigen-receptor interactions; not anchored to a specific primary source. Candidate for submodel-target extraction.
